value.title: Race Conditions & Concurrent Request State Subversion Methodology
value.content: {"id": "portswigger_race_conditions", "item_type": "methodology", "topic": "race_conditions", "category": "PortSwigger Web Security: Race Conditions & Concurrency", "name": "Race Conditions & Concurrent Request State Subversion Methodology", "cwe": "CWE-362", "owasp_category": "A04:2021 - Insecure Design", "signals": ["limit_overrun_vulnerability", "multi_endpoint_race_window", "time_of_check_time_of_use_toctou", "single_use_token_reuse_under_load", "partial_state_subversion"], "verification_strategy": "Synchronize a burst of identical state-changing requests (e.g. 20-30 requests) using HTTP/2 single-packet multiplexing or TCP packet alignment. Measure if the application processes multiple transactions concurrently before the database commit or balance check finalizes.", "evidence_requirements": ["concurrent_status_200_cluster", "balance_deficit_proof", "multiple_redemption_evidence"], "tools": [{"tool": "Turbo Intruder", "cmd": "turbo_intruder.race_single_packet_engine(request, count=30)", "desc": "High-speed concurrent request engine sending requests within a single TCP packet"}, {"tool": "AutonomousBrain (Concurrency)", "cmd": "AutonomousBrain.probe_race_window(url, post_data)", "desc": "Audits atomic locking mechanisms on sensitive transaction endpoints"}], "remediation": "Use atomic database operations (e.g. UPDATE ... WHERE balance >= amount) or apply row-level locking (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE). Enforce distributed locks (e.g. Redis Redlock) during critical transaction sections.", "description": "PortSwigger Race Conditions labs cover limit overrun vulnerabilities (redeeming gift cards multiple times), multi-endpoint race conditions subverting email verification flows, and time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) file race conditions."}
